lines.deva: नमो अरिहंताणं नमो सिद्धाणं नमो आयरियाणं नमो उवज्झायाणं नमो लोए सव्वसाहूणं ।
lines.iast: Namo arihaṃtāṇaṃ namo siddhāṇaṃ namo āyariyāṇaṃ namo uvajjhāyāṇaṃ namo loe savva-sāhūṇaṃ.
lines.en: Homage to the Arhats, homage to the Siddhas, homage to the Ācāryas, homage to the Upādhyāyas, homage to all the sādhus in the world.

lines.deva: एसो पंचनमोक्कारो सव्वपावप्पणासणो । मंगलाणं च सव्वेसिं पढमं हवइ मंगलं ॥
lines.iast: eso paṃca-namokkāro savva-pāva-ppaṇāsaṇo maṃgalāṇaṃ ca savvesiṃ paḍhamaṃ havai maṃgalaṃ.
lines.en: This fivefold salutation destroys all evil, and of all blessings it is the first blessing.

lines.deva: तेणं कालेणं तेणं समएणं समणे भगवं महावीरे पंचहत्थुत्तरे होत्था ।
lines.iast: Teṇaṃ kāleṇaṃ teṇaṃ samaeṇaṃ samaṇe bhagavaṃ Mahāvīre paṃca-hatth’uttare hotthā;
lines.en: In that age, at that time, the ascetic Mahāvīra, the Blessed One, had five events under the asterism Hastottarā:

lines.deva: गय वसह सीह अभिसेय दाम ससि दिणयरं झयं कुंभं । पउमसर सागर विमाण- भवण रयणुच्चय सिहिं च ॥
lines.iast: gaya vasaha sīha abhiseya dāma sasi diṇayaraṃ jhayaṃ kuṃbhaṃ paumasara sāgara vimāṇa- bhavaṇa rayaṇ’-uccaya sihiṃ ca.
lines.en: An elephant, a bull, a lion, the anointing of the goddess Śrī, a garland, the moon, the sun, a banner, a jar, a lotus lake, the ocean, a heavenly palace, a heap of jewels and a flame.
